sentences: Traders moved $696 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-04-27, across 27.6 million individual trades, with 13,216 wallets placing their first-ever bet (below the recent trend). Algorithmic wallets accounted for 87% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 13%.
The most-traded market was "Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the April 2026 meeting?", pulling in $6 million of volume. Macro calls drove the action.
The usual pattern held: algorithmic traders made $80K (+69 bps on volume) while retail traders lost $83K (-432 bps).
